name: buckley-large-20
original:
add(tool): add byte-offset pagination to git diff tool

- Return bounded diff pages with byte_offset, total_bytes, next_byte_offset, and a SHA-256 of the full patch so large diffs can be read incrementally
- Accept byte_offset, max_bytes, and expected_sha256 parameters; reject mismatched hashes and invalid offsets instead of mixing revisions
- End pages at line boundaries or valid UTF-8 so reconstructed output matches the exact patch
